findings.finding: Common marketing term for publishing on an established third-party domain. It is separate from publishing a future-planning article on Nonlate. Google defines site reputation abuse around third-party content published mainly to exploit a host’s established ranking signals. No third-party publishing is part of this release.

An early planning guide can serve a current decision. A future year in a title does not establish a ranking advantage. Use the actual publication date and currently verified facts; do not claim future testing, awards, prices or guaranteed rankings. One useful 2027 checklist is preferred to substantially similar month/year pages.
